name: Pinterest, Inc.
moat_justification: A genuinely differentiated commercial-intent dataset (Taste Graph, 80B+ monthly searches, 640M MAUs) and ~80% gross margins, but the ROIC proxy was negative in 2022-23 and only ~7.9% in 2025 — pricing power unproven through a cycle — while the international ARPU gap (Q2 2026: UCAN $8.30 vs ROW $0.23) closes slowly and Meta/Google/TikTok replicate visual search.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2018 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 0.54 vs 3-yr median 0.25 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 2.0% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.4x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Real commercial-intent franchise, moat 5/10, but SBC eats 77% of TTM operating cash flow — at $21.91 it returns 6.5% weighted and only clears the 15% hurdle below $6.25.
moat_for: Taste Graph / human-curation dataset behind 80B+ monthly searches with explicit commercial intent
640M MAUs, 12 consecutive record quarters, Gen Z the fastest-growing cohort
~80% gross margin (80.1% in FY2025) ad economics
Performance+ and Visual Search Ads extending into lower-funnel monetization
moat_against: ROIC proxy negative in 2022-23, only ~7.9% in 2025 — no through-cycle pricing-power proof
International monetization gap closes slowly (Q2 2026 ARPU: Europe $1.35, ROW $0.23 vs UCAN $8.30)
Users and advertisers multi-home; Meta, Google Lens, TikTok and Amazon replicate visual search
SBC consumes 77% of TTM operating cash flow — talent costs eat the franchise economics
